mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_document_chunk_task (document_id, task_type, task_status, retry_count) VALUES (#{documentId}, #{taskType}, #{taskStatus}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_document_chunk_task SET task_type = #{taskType}, task_status = #{taskStatus}, retry_count = retry_count + 1, started_at = NULL, ended_at = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE document_id = #{documentId}
UPDATE kb_document_chunk_task SET task_status = 'PROCESSING', started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, ended_at = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE document_id = #{documentId}
mapper.select: SELECT task_status FROM kb_document_chunk_task WHERE document_id = #{documentId}
